opus.problem: Exodus 28:12 says only 'both stones' on the shoulder pieces. It does not say they are onyx or engraved; those details are in Exodus 28:9-11. Widen the reference to Exodus 28:9-12, or drop 'onyx' and 'engraved'.

Judges 8:27 says only 'From all this Gideon made an ephod'. The gold earrings are in Judges 8:24-26, where the BSB also calls the earring-wearers Ishmaelites. Widen the reference to Judges 8:24-27, or reword the clue to match the cited verse.
2 Samuel 6:14 does not mention the ark being brought up; that is in 6:15. Widen the reference to 2 Samuel 6:14-15.
1 Samuel 23:9 does not name Keilah; the place is in 23:8 and 23:10. Widen the reference to 1 Samuel 23:8-10, or drop 'at Keilah'.
